2609.39645.title: SEPAL: Separated Expert Pairs with Answer-Level Fusion for Reliable LLM Collaboration
2609.39645.paper_summary: Multi-agent collaboration lets large language models (LLMs) improve question answering through deliberation and feedback. Yet shared discussion couples correction with exposure to the same mistakes, which can erode the diversity needed for voting. Self-consistency offers sampling diversity without feedback, while single-pair Actor-Critic collaboration refines only one candidate. We introduce SEPAL, which assigns three private Actor-Critic teams to direct reasoning, evidence grounding, and verification. Role-specific training gives the teams different reasoning objectives beyond sampling variation. Each Critic guides revisions within its own team, preventing feedback from carrying errors across candidates. Once revision ends, majority voting combines only the final answers, keeping the reasoning histories separate until the decision. Across five open-weight backbones and five question-answering benchmarks, SEPAL improves mean accuracy by 1.81 percentage points over a matched single Actor-Critic pair, with improvements across all five backbones. Code is available at https://github.com/zhansan114514/SEPAL.
2609.39645.paper_summary_zh: 多智能體合作讓大型語言模型（LLMs）透過深思熟慮和反饋來改善問題回答。<lb/>然而，共享討論將修正與暴露於相同錯誤結合在一起，這可能會侵蝕投票所需的多樣性。<lb/>自我一致性提供了無需反饋的抽樣多樣性，而單對單的演員-評論家合作僅精煉一個候選者。<lb/>我們介紹了SEPAL，它指派三個私有的演員-評論家團隊來進行推理、證據基礎和驗證。<lb/>角色特定的訓練使這些團隊擁有不同的推理目標，超越了抽樣變異。<lb/>每個評論家在其自己的團隊內指導修訂，防止反饋將錯誤傳遞到其他候選者。<lb/>一旦修訂結束，多數投票僅結合最終答案，保持推理歷史在決策之前是分開的。<lb/>在五個開放權重的骨幹和五個問題回答基準上，SEPAL使平均準確率比匹配的單一演員-評論家對提高了1.81個百分點，並在所有五個骨幹上都有所改善。<lb/>代碼可在 https://github.com/zhansan114514/SEPAL 獲得。
